cc:Work.dc:title: Box - UniversalBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with various options for different styles and lids
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes UniversalBox --x 110 --y 80 --h 60 --outside 0 --bottom_edge s --top_edge t --vertical_edges 'finger joints' --RoundedTriangleEdge_height 40 --RoundedTriangleEdge_radius 25 --RoundedTriangleEdge_r_hole 3 --RoundedTriangleEdge_outset 1 --thickness 4 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes UniversalBox --x --y --h --outside --bottom_edge --top_edge --RoundedTriangleEdge_height --RoundedTriangleEdge_radius --RoundedTriangleEdge_r_hole --thickness --burn --reference --labels
